[open4/kn5000-b-cpanel] 2026-10-31 (lane open4/kn5000-b-cpanel): analog controllers identified and renamed in v10/v9/v7/v6/v5 (scripts/renaming/rename_open4_cpanel.sed, 108 rules). From the service manual (CPL sheet II-35: AD1 BEND, AD2 MOD, AD3 MAIN VOLUME VR1, AD0 grounded; CPU sheet II-11: AN0 EXP pedal, AN1 AFT after-touch) and the firmware's panel-record tags (0xB1 pitch bend, 0xB2 modulation, 0xB0+1 TOTAL EXPRESSION / 0xB3 part expression, 0xB4 channel pressure): id 25 = pitch bend (Encoder_ProcessPitchBend, 14-bit split, centre dead band, bend-range rescale while recording), 26 = modulation (Encoder_ProcessModulation), 27 = MAIN VOLUME (Encoder_ProcessMainVolume, record 0xB0 +0, inferred), 2 = expression pedal on CPU AN0 (Encoder_ProcessExpressionPedal, FOOT CONTROLLERS assignment 182/183), 5 = after touch on CPU AN1 (Encoder_ProcessAfterTouch, threshold + curve from record 0x93). The old breath/foot/volume-slider/modwheel names were wrong. Evidence, rename table and the website draft (control-panel-protocol.md sections 3, 5, 6; hardware-architecture.md) in notes/open4-kn5000-b/cpanel/README.md. Caveats: id = 24 + AD channel and record 0xB0 byte 0 = master volume are inferences (panel MCU ROM undumped). Outcome: repo work CLOSED; leave open until the docs lane publishes the draft.

[open4/kn5000-b-cpanel] 2026-10-31 (lane open4/kn5000-b-cpanel): frame types 6/7 decoded from CPanel_RX_MultiBytePacket / CPanel_SM_RXByte1: H0 bits 7:6 panel, 5:4 = 11, 3:0 = N-1 (N = 1..16; type 7 is just a run longer than 8), H1 bits 4:0 = first segment (bit 4 clear) or controller id (bit 4 set), then N state bytes -> one record per byte. [open4/kn5000-b-midi] 2026-10-31 (wave 4, lane kn5000-b, sub-lane midi), branch open4/kn5000-b-midi. Traced the readers of the three part bytes the proprietary CCs store. CC 0x91 (part+0x17) is the part's own velocity-switch configuration, twin of the global 0x04134B (F0 50 91, Voice_SetVelSwitchConfig): read only by Voice_Env_ApplyVelocity_Type0/_Type2, it gates the install of the patch's +0x2A octave-shift nibble; sent by SwbtB2_Code9A_Listener for parts 0-2. CC 0x9B (part+0x25) patches bits 11:9 / 14:12 of the voice gate word in Voice_Apply_GateRouting (nibble 0 = force 7, 1 = leave, 2 = force 1; reset 1). CC 0x9D (part+0x26) overrides the low 7 bits of TG register 0x180 (pan): 1 = 0x00, 2 = 0x7F, else the voice's own value (reset 0). No main-CPU sender of 0x9B / 0x9D was found in v10 (search method in the notes). Renamed Voice_CC_91/9B/9D and their setters (Voice_CC_VelSwitchConfig / GateRoutingMode / TgPanMode), fixed the headers and Voice_ResetAllControllers' reset list. Website page draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/midi/README.md section 'kn5000-5ck', draft for midi-subsystem.md (proprietary-controller table and the stale Research Needed line). Outcome: repo-side work CLOSED; leave open until the docs lane publishes the draft.

[open4/kn5000-b-hdae] Wave 4 (open4/kn5000-b-hdae), repo side done; leave open until the docs lane publishes. All three open questions of hdae5000-filesystem.md are answered from the code: (1) the song record holds 10 part-present flags at +26+k (1 saved / 0 deleted, set by each HDAE5000_SaveSong_<part>, cleared by DeleteSongPart_<part>) and 10 first-cluster slots at +36+4k; parts 0-8 = LSW PMT SQT CMP TM MSP RCM MD TLX; flag +35 and slot +72 are written only by a format (spare); v1.x has 8 parts. (2) FLS item bytes +80/+112 are the manual's AS (AUTO START) and AL (AUTO LOAD) options: edit switches 6/7, '*' in the lists, AS presses the sequencer start after loading, AL arms the chain that loads the next item 0x53 ticks after the sequencer stops. (3) 'FSB' is the whole table set: commands 03/06 load/store all 323 table sectors, 04/05 move blocks 0, 1 and 2. Renamed in all four HD-AE5000 trees: HDAE5000_FlsItem_SetAutoStart/SetAutoLoad, HDAE5000_Fls_GetAutoLoadPending/SetSeqStopPending, HDAE5000_RAM_FlsChainFls/FlsChainItem/FlsAutoLoadPending/FlsSeqStopPending. Command 20 (v2.x only) traced: service 29 (RootFn_SleepMainTask), receive request+2 bytes into work DRAM 0x010000, service 28 calls SRAM 0x23FEB0 with XWA=0x10000 and the descriptor {'XAP', &count, 0x280000, 0x2F0000}, service 30 (RootFn_WakeUpMainTask), 'End Flash Right' when the call returns 0x58. No version or data check (the link's only version check is command 01's). Caveat, with evidence: nothing in any HD-AE5000, main-CPU, table-data or custom-data image puts code at 0x23FEB0, no link command writes a PC-chosen address, and HD-TechManager5000 v1.40's ppkn50.dll never sends command 20, so the path is unusable with the surviving firmware/software; the type-6 floppy is the working path. Services 29/30 renamed in the v2.x trees. Website page draft: notes/open4-kn5000-b/hdae/README.md, section 'kn5000-e7f'.

[open4/kn5000-b-engine] 2026-10-31 (lane open4/kn5000-b, sub-lane engine): traced. The allocator is Voice_Allocate_Nodes over 64 voice nodes (0x148D, 39 B) in 18 pools of 30 B at 0x112D (+0 quota, +1 count, seven class heads); each of 27 parts points to a pool (Voice_Part_PoolPtr_ModeA/_ModeB); pool 16 holds stolen voices, pool 17 is the free list (0x1345, which the old header read as a 'forced/override node'). Classes = voice state: 0-2 sounding, 3-5 released, 6 decayed/free. Per layer, Voice_LayerClassTable gives a search list (free first, then decayed > released > sounding, stolen before own); at the pool quota Voice_FindStealCandidate moves the pool's lowest-ranked voice to pool 16. Quotas by mode (system sub-command 0x09): A 32/16/4/12, B 16 pools summing to 64. Reaping: Voice_Manager_PollBank. The issue's '16 voice slots at 0x4A4C' is the held-key map, not the allocator. Renames and table respellings in v142 (v141/v140 regenerated). Notes and the website draft for audio-subsystem.md: notes/open4-kn5000-b/engine/README.md section kn5000-rlb. Repo-side work complete; leave open until the draft is published.

[open4/kn5000-b-accvar] 2026-10-31 (lane open4/kn5000-b, sub-lane accvar): the play-time section state machine is traced and named (notes/open4-kn5000-b/accvar/README.md). The style-control buttons set request bits in the style record (record 0x48 field 5: bit 2 INTRO1, 3 COUNT IN, 4/5 ENDING1/2, 6/7 FILL IN1/2; field 6 bit 2 INTRO2; field 7 bits 4-5 VARIATION), which are also the LEDs; the routines that did this were misnamed AccPedal_SustainOn/_HoldOn/_PortamentoOn... and are now AccStyleCtl_* / AccSection_* in all trees (scripts/renaming/rename_open4_accvar.sed, 277 rules). INTRO & ENDING gives an intro when stopped, an ending when running (front-panel events only); FILL IN 2 when stopped gives COUNT IN. SeqTick_ReadControlState copies the bits into ACC_REQ_INTRO/FILLIN/ENDING each tick; a rising edge latches a pending section (AccSection_Latch*Requests). A fill-in or intro starts at once unless pressed on the last beat (then at the bar line); an ending waits for the bar line unless pressed on the first beat. AccSection_SwitchAtBarLine dispatches through AccSection_BarLineSwitchTable (ending > fill-in > intro; a pending variation loads first); under the MUSIC STYLE ARRANGER FILL IN 1/2 step the variation down/up. A section ends when its last lane reaches the end marker (Rhythm_SaveState clears the request and the LED; after a fill or intro the variation resumes, after an ending 0x3284 bit 2 is set, the same bit as after a fill, so the stop after an ending is not established). RAM names added (ACC_REQ_*, ACC_PENDING_*, ACC_LANES_*, ACC_DEFER_*, ACC_SECTION_BUTTONS_HELD, PANEL_EVENT_SOURCE ...; v10/v9/v7, notes/open4-kn5000-b/accvar/ram-names.txt).
